metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a Rust (stable, 2021) no-dependency Cargo project under `output/` that builds and runs as required and produces the specified JSON output files.

- Project: `output/Cargo.toml` (empty `[dependencies]`), entrypoint `output/src/main.rs`
- Core implementation: `output/src/sim.rs`
- CLI supports: `--input`, `--output`, optional `--tool-table`, `--block-delete`, `--carousel-slots`, `--parameter-input`, `--parameter-output`, `--probe-box`, `--probe-tool`, and `--trace-output` plus exactly one of `--trace-time-step` / `--trace-distance-step` / `--trace-position-tolerance`
- Writes `--output` JSON on both success and error; writes `--trace-output` JSON on both success and error (with `initial_state` omitting the `error` field); writes `--parameter-output` only on success.

Build/run:
- `cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml`
- `cargo run --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml -- --input <file> --output <file> [other args]`
